title: Sign in with valid credentials
expected: User is signed in and sees the account page.

title: Reject an incorrect password
steps: Enter the registered email and an incorrect password
expected: Sign-in is rejected and a clear error is shown.

title: Require an email address
expected: The form asks for the required email and does not sign in.

title: Require a password
expected: The form asks for the required password and does not sign in.

title: Create a booking with valid details
preconditions: The user is signed in and the booking form is open.
expected: The booking is saved and its details are displayed.

title: Reject checkout before check-in
steps: Enter a checkout date earlier than the check-in date
expected: The form rejects the date range and explains the issue.

title: Reject equal check-in and checkout dates
steps: Enter the same date for check-in and checkout
expected: The form applies its documented minimum-stay rule.

title: View an existing booking
preconditions: A booking exists for the sample user.
expected: The selected booking details are displayed accurately.

title: Update booking details
preconditions: A booking exists and is open for editing.
expected: The saved booking displays the updated guest name.

title: Cancel a booking
preconditions: A booking exists and is eligible for cancellation.
expected: The booking is cancelled and no longer appears as active.
